#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

struct Point {
    long long x1, x2, x3, x4, x5;
    Point(long long x1, long long x2, long long x3, long long x4, long long x5) 
        : x1(x1), x2(x2), x3(x3), x4(x4), x5(x5) {}
    long long prod(const Point& other) const {
        return x1 * other.x1 + x2 * other.x2 + x3 * other.x3 + x4 * other.x4 + x5 * other.x5;
    }
    Point sub(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x1 - other.x1, x2 - other.x2, x3 - other.x3, x4 - other.x4, x5 - other.x5);
    }
};

bool check(const vector<Point>& points, int n, int i) {
    vector<Point> vectors;
    Point base = points[i];
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        if (j != i) vectors.push_back(points[j].sub(base));
    }
    int m = vectors.size();
    for (int a = 0; a < m; ++a) {
        for (int b = a + 1; b < m; ++b) {
            if (vectors[a].prod(vectors[b]) > 0) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    if (n > 11) {
        printf("0\n");
        fflush(stdout);
        return 0;
    }

    vector<Point> points;
    points.reserve(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        long long x1, x2, x3, x4, x5;
        scanf("%lld %lld %lld %lld %lld", &x1, &x2, &x3, &x4, &x5);
        points.push_back(Point(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5));
    }

    vector<int> ret;
    ret.reserve(11);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (check(points, n, i)) ret.push_back(i + 1);
    }

    printf("%d\n", (int)ret.size());
    for (int x : ret) {
        printf("%d\n", x);
    }
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}
